what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site sweeps a dark curtain from the top left of the screen to the bottom right, with a cloud-like noisy edge (the edge slightly brighter and the screen ahead of it 9% darker), covering in 1.1 seconds and navigating. On the arriving page the curtain lifts toward the same side in 1.35 seconds. While sweeping, fx-wiping is attached to html so text and buttons on screen can be hidden (WebGL shader)

options.dur: Length of one cover + walk cycle (seconds), default 2.45 — cover takes .45 share, walk .55 share. Shorten it for apps with frequent navigation
options.noise: Noise scale, default 7.3 — the larger, the finer the cloud edges
options.rough: Share of noise mixed in instead of the diagonal (0–1), default 0.21
options.shade: How much the screen just before the edge is darkened, default 0.09
options.--fx-veil: Curtain color, default 89% toward the background between background and text color (original #262626)
options.[data-fx-part=hide]: Child that hides in 0.2s while the sweep runs (progress 0 to 1.6) — the original hides all on-screen text such as menu, captions and title

use: <body data-fx="noise-wipe-page"> · To skip faster: data-fx-noise-wipe-page="dur: 1.2" · On-screen text is <nav data-fx-part="hide">

from.where: shared.js makeVeil (the veil in the original scene post-processing — progress 0→1 cover 2.45s×.45 sine.out, 1→2 uncover ×.55 sine.inOut, diagonal mixed with 3-layer noise .21, edge .13, shadow .09, curtain #262626, .veilHide hides it during progress 0~1.6 in .2s)

note: The original refracts (.12) the scene image at the edges, but under the part’s overlay is DOM, so there is no refraction. The noise is our own 3-layer value noise, so the cloud pattern differs from the original. If WebGL is absent, it skips ahead immediately without waiting
